notes.title: Update 08 11 2023
notes.notes: Very small update. Couple typos and Syl portrait error in hotel scene.

notes.title: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
Just a few minor updates to the game:

-An enhanced introduction (including Marcone voice-line)
-New system in place to avoid situations where players are required to make dialogue choices without still being able to see what was last said.
-Improved gunshot sounds.

notes.title: New Ending Update
notes.notes:
A new somewhat-Halloween-themed ending for the game that serves to better reflect the unique decisions you made along the way. Inspired by Purgatorio from the Divine Comedy.
"In this thing of ours, there are many roads. Few if any good intentions... But it always ends the same way..." 
"All yous can do is figure out whos you're taking with yous..."
